## Purpose / linked issue
Closes #<!-- issue -->

## Change category
- [ ] Runtime / ASR / MT / glossary
- [ ] UI / operator / audience
- [ ] Benchmark / tests
- [ ] Documentation / maintenance

## Verification (paste actual commands and outcomes)
- [ ] Tests / lint / typecheck applicable to changed code
- [ ] CI / CodeQL reviewed for the exact PR head SHA
- [ ] No secrets, private recordings or model weights committed
- [ ] If runtime path changed: bounded queue, cancellation, reconnection, stale results and fail-closed behavior assessed
- [ ] If multilingual path changed: ko/en/ja directions and source-language glossary effects assessed
- [ ] If performance claimed: model SHA, hardware, fixture license/hash, cold/warm repetitions and JSON results attached

## Evidence and limitations
Describe observed results separately from assumptions. Synthetic smoke tests are **not** real-speech accuracy, 4/8GB hardware qualification, or 30/60/90-minute field acceptance.

## Rollback / compatibility
Explain migrations, compatibility and how to revert safely (or state not applicable).
